Class ReportSession

java.lang.Object
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.ReportSession
public final class ReportSession extends Object
Session-scoped state and finalization shared by the two components that must cooperate at session end: BuildReportSpy (event collection, SessionEnded) and GateKeeper (afterSessionEnd enforcement).

Their relative ordering at the end of a Maven session is a core implementation detail this extension does not depend on: finalizeAndWrite() is idempotent, whichever component calls it first performs the write, and both receive the same GateVerdict. All state is static for the same reason ModelObservations is — the spy is a classic sisu component and the observer a new-API component, in separate DI containers on one extension classloader. reset() runs at ProjectDiscoveryStarted so long-lived JVMs (the IDE's maven-server) start every session clean.

    • HISTORY_RELATIVE_PATH

      public static final String HISTORY_RELATIVE_PATH
      Where receipts that demanded attention are kept, relative to the execution root.

      The receipt at the root is overwritten every session, so a clean run silently erases the evidence for the failing run that preceded it — the reader goes looking and finds gate: clean. Sessions with findings therefore also leave a timestamped copy here (ike-issues#989).

      See Also:

    • finalizeAndWrite

      public static GateVerdict finalizeAndWrite()
      Finalizes the session exactly once: evaluates the ledger, writes the receipt and the observations sidecar, and computes the gate verdict. Safe to call from both the spy and the gate participant; the second caller receives the first caller's verdict.

      Never throws — a reporting failure degrades to a log line and a permissive verdict.

      Returns:
      the session's gate verdict
